body: Generator and runtime tests must be input-space matrices run end to end, never snapshots of current output. For every type-mapping, selector, builder or batch change: combine the dimensions (GraphQL kind x nullability x list depth x binding shape x position x odd names such as reserved words and case-only clashes), generate a real SDK, compile it under strict settings (tsc --strict --noUnusedLocals across commonjs/bundler/nodenext; go build + vet), and run it against mockapi via task examples:test. A test that asserts whatever the generator emits today is a bug magnet: one such test pinned unbound scalars to any, and line coverage hid issue #5 (union binding inside a list) because the line ran without the combination. Why: on 2026-10-13 a docs pass that ran every feature against a live server surfaced 30+ bugs (unusable unions in Go and TS, 422 errors not typed, RawQuery empty, TS null typing, mock-server races) that the existing suite never exercised.
